lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p20 - 1. Listen and point.

details: Listen and point checks understanding of word meaning and sound as students match what they hear to the right image.
Look for careful listening and correct pointing to the appropriate image.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p46 - Colour the spaces with dots

details: Colour the spaces with dots gives students an opportunity to practice their fine motor skills and helps prepare them for slightly freer practice of the target language.
Look for careful colouring using dots, mostly within the lines, students colouring the spaces with dots only.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down:

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p46 - Ask and answer ‘what’s this?’

details: Ask and answer ‘what’s this?’ provides freer practice of the target language, improves fluency and strengthens students’ awareness of turn taking during pairwork.
Look for accurate pronunciation, stress and intonation, careful listening, accurate use of the target language and key structure, and natural turn-taking with classmates.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p20 - 4. What is it? Look and draw.

details: What is it? Look and draw gives students the opportunity to demonstrate understanding of the target vocabulary by identifying an item and completing a simple drawing.
Look for students looking carefully at the picture before drawing, simple drawings that clearly represent the target item and effort to draw within the space provided.
